expo.name: Apnajoda
expo.description: Serious, verified dating for India. Built for people looking for a real relationship, not casual swiping.

plugins.photosPermission: Apnajoda needs photo access so you can build your relationship profile.
plugins.cameraPermission: Apnajoda uses the camera for profile photos and selfie verification.

plugins.microphonePermission: Apnajoda uses the microphone to record your optional voice introduction.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Apnajoda uses approximate location only when you enable Crossed Paths. Your exact location is never shown to other members.

plugins.contactsPermission: Apnajoda uses your contacts to help you find friends who are already on the app. Your contact list is never stored on our servers.

plugins.cameraPermission: Apnajoda uses the camera for video calls with your matches.
plugins.microphonePermission: Apnajoda uses the microphone for voice and video calls with your matches.
